brief: 방한용품·따뜻한 한 잔 배너의 제목과 분류명을 조금 아래로 이동
assembly: image_gen으로 글자 뒤 배경을 복원하고 원본 글자 픽셀만 이동. 원본의 사진·서체·크기·문구를 보존. PC 크롭 유지, 모바일 원본 유지.

assets.prompt: Edit this existing photograph by removing ONLY all of the Korean headline and small category text on the LEFT. Reconstruct the exact continuous photographic background underneath those letters. Preserve the exact original dimensions, composition, light, tones, textures, all objects and product package printing, and every other pixel as closely as possible. This clean background is an intermediate layer for moving the ORIGINAL lettering downward without changing its font or the product photograph. Do not add any text, symbols, logos, borders, watermarks or extra objects. Output the same 2172 by 724 landscape 3:1 photograph.
